method: Root manual unblinded inspection of every complete immutable endpoint patch, exact public APIs, delivered tests, command chronology and delivery. Hash-bound independent endpoint checks support the judgment; official completion alone is insufficient. Symbolic relevance/witness judgments require separate explicit review.

decisions.name: 1-alternative-selections-reference
evidence: Shared internal matchPatternTransactional evaluates each alternative once, stages callback values locally and publishes only the first successful pattern; both MatchExpression.with and P.union import/use it, preserving short-circuit and guard evaluation. Union retains its own declared-key undefined initialization; total mismatch cannot commit partial values. Public match/union/type interfaces unchanged. New5 tests cover named isolation, union defaults, anonymous, mismatch fallback and guard transition. Initial new tests used a b-only literal input while testing an a/b alternative; delivered compiler33 rejects it, edit36 widens only test input to the intended original public union (no API weakening). Further actual test additions41/47 strengthen coverage and each invalidates previous final-source checks; final required48/49/50 and delivered types51 pass. All five independent endpoints and protected/dependency integrity pass, no retrieval and scoped truthful delivery. Repeated full checks after incremental test additions remain measured costs, not same-source duplicates.
